_comment: FairSpot Cloudflare rate-limit rules (SEC010 / #764). Codified, versioned form of docs/security/cloudflare-waf-profile.md section 3. Apply to the http_ratelimit phase entrypoint ruleset for the zone. Counting rate limits require Cloudflare Pro or above. Contains NO secrets: replace REPLACE_WITH_DOMAIN with the operator domain. Thresholds are conservative pilot defaults — tune per section 3.6. Per-IP counting (ip.src); Business+ operators may switch booking counting to a JWT/cookie characteristic (see README.md).
name: FairSpot rate-limit rules

rules.description: FPS — Rate limit login and token
rules.expression: (http.host eq "auth.REPLACE_WITH_DOMAIN" and http.request.uri.path contains "/protocol/openid-connect/token") or (http.host eq "app.REPLACE_WITH_DOMAIN" and http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/token"))
(http.host eq "app.REPLACE_WITH_DOMAIN" and http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bookings"))
(http.host eq "app.REPLACE_WITH_DOMAIN" and http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/draws"))
(http.host eq "app.REPLACE_WITH_DOMAIN" and http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bookings/") and http.request.uri.path contains "/cancel")
(http.host eq "app.REPLACE_WITH_DOMAIN" and http.request.method eq "POST" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/import") or http.request.uri.path contains "/import"))
